major_cooldowns.name: Zenith
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Bank one of the two charges and send Zenith with your potion, racial, trinkets and Bloodlust, then fill with free Blackout Kick to pull Rising Sun Kick and Fists of Fury back faster.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 1249625 is both the cast and the self buff in the ability table; talents can shorten the listed 90s base to 60, 70 or 80 seconds.

major_cooldowns.name: Invoke Xuen, the White Tiger
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Plan a spare global for Invoke Xuen so you can channel Celestial Conduit inside its window instead of losing damage to the summon.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Not pressed in the sampled parses but castable per its tooltip.

major_cooldowns.name: Celestial Conduit
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Space Celestial Conduit between your Strike of the Windlord and Whirling Dragon Punch casts so its Heart of the Jade Serpent does not overlap theirs.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Not pressed in the sampled parses but castable per its tooltip; 443038 shares the name with no cooldown.

major_cooldowns.name: Strike of the Windlord
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Send Strike of the Windlord as soon as it is up, but hold it while the Heart of the Jade Serpent from Celestial Conduit is still running.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Not pressed in the sampled parses but castable per its tooltip.

major_cooldowns.name: Whirling Dragon Punch
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press Whirling Dragon Punch the moment Rising Sun Kick and Fists of Fury are both on cooldown, and skip it while the Heart of the Jade Serpent from Celestial Conduit is up.

major_cooldowns.name: Touch of Death
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Fire Touch of Death as soon as you can fit it without delaying a higher priority button, and press Fortifying Brew first when you can so it snapshots more health.

major_cooldowns.name: Slicing Winds
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Pre-cast Slicing Winds before the pull, then press it whenever nothing higher on the priority is ready.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Not pressed in the sampled parses but castable per its tooltip.

defensives.name: Touch of Karma
defensives.usage_rule: Drop Touch of Karma into predictable incoming damage so the absorbed hit is redirected back at your target.

defensives.name: Fortifying Brew
defensives.usage_rule: Press Fortifying Brew before Touch of Karma or Touch of Death so both snapshot the extra maximum health.

defensives.name: Dampen Harm
defensives.usage_rule: Use Dampen Harm ahead of a large hit, since it cuts the biggest attacks the hardest.
defensives.id_note: Not pressed in the sampled parses but castable per its tooltip; 175395 shares the name with a 90s cooldown.

defensives.name: Diffuse Magic
defensives.usage_rule: Save Diffuse Magic for heavy magic damage and to send a harmful debuff back to its caster.
defensives.id_note: Not pressed in the sampled parses but castable per its tooltip.

defensives.name: Zen Meditation
defensives.usage_rule: Channel Zen Meditation for a telegraphed magic hit and expect any melee swing to break it.
defensives.id_note: Not pressed in the sampled parses but castable per its tooltip.

defensives.name: Expel Harm
defensives.usage_rule: Press Expel Harm on a spare global to top yourself up between damage events.
defensives.id_note: Not pressed in the sampled parses but castable per its tooltip.

rules.description: Open Tiger Palm into Zenith, Fists of Fury, Rising Sun Kick
rules.action: Lead with Tiger Palm, send Zenith after your stat buffs, then Fists of Fury into Rising Sun Kick.

rules.description: Blackout Kick is your filler inside Zenith
rules.action: Fill with free Blackout Kick while Zenith is up and press Tiger Palm only when you are short on Chi.
Work the free Blackout Kick in before the proc expires rather than stacking it.

rules.description: Tiger Palm only when you need the Chi
rules.action: Press Blackout Kick or a spender when Chi is high and keep Tiger Palm for refilling it.

rules.description: Spinning Crane Kick from three targets
rules.action: Swap your filler over to Spinning Crane Kick once three or more enemies are in range.

rules.description: Celestial Conduit outside Heart of the Jade Serpent
rules.action: Let the Heart of the Jade Serpent from Strike of the Windlord or Whirling Dragon Punch run out before you channel Celestial Conduit.

source_summary: Windwalker keeps its short cooldowns rolling and builds every burst window around Zenith, which banks two charges so you can line one up with a potion, trinkets, or Bloodlust and then spam free Blackout Kick to reset Rising Sun Kick and Fists of Fury. Conduit of the Celestials adds Invoke Xuen and Celestial Conduit, which have to be staggered against the Heart of the Jade Serpent buff that Strike of the Windlord and Whirling Dragon Punch already grant. Touch of Death goes out as soon as a spare global appears, and pressing Fortifying Brew before it or before Touch of Karma turns a defensive into extra damage.
